data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leave 50, and let the lake replenish to 100. That’s $10,000 apiece every month if we stick to it, without risking the village’s livelihood. I propose we all agree to that limit and review everyone’s catches together each month. John, would you commit to 10 tons?
